<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parameter-expansion'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY combined "&base; and &ent;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="test"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Leading comment before complex CDATA and entities -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA section with markup: <root>&combined;</root> inside.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&combined;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_macro "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>">
  %local_macro;
  <!ENTITY internal "Internal Text">
  <!ENTITY reference "&internal; with recursion check">
]>
<?xml-pi target="processor" data="start-sequence"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment 1: Description of section A -->
  <section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing entity reference simulation: &reference;
    ]]>
  </section>
  <!-- Comment 2: Description of section B -->
  <section id="s2">&reference;</section>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "Value A">
  <!ENTITY entB "Value B &entA;">
  <!ENTITY entC "Value C &entB;">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ATTLIST record category CDATA #REQUIRED>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" type="text/css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.archive.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://xml.archive.org/meta" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Top-level comment explaining entities and namespaces -->
  <meta:info>
    <?meta-control action="verify" timestamp="2023-10-01"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Metadata CDATA block with unescaped entities like &entC; inside.
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <record category="primary">&entC;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY brand "Acme Corp">
  <!ENTITY product "&brand; Widget">
  <!ENTITY % ext_decl "<!ENTITY dynamic 'Loaded Dynamically'>">
  %ext_decl;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction data="diagnostic-mode=true"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/inventory" xmlns:store="http://schemas.example.com/store">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA block -->
  <store:item code="X99">
    <![CDATA[
      Special inventory data: <item>&product;</item> &dynamic;
    ]]>
  </store:item>
  <item>&product; - &dynamic;</item>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha-Value">
  <!ENTITY beta "Beta-Value α">
  <!ENTITY gamma "Gamma-Value β">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="db.css"?>
<?database-control mode="read-write" timeout="30"?>
<database xmlns="http://db.example.org/ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comment verifying complex entity expansion chains -->
  <record xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="internal">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block encapsulating entity chain: γ
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>γ</record>
</database>
